entries.title: Blue Lock Clicker 0.3.0 Update
entries.body:
Blue Lock Clicker has been updated to version 0.3.0.

New Features:
- ALL plushies are now in the game!
- Added a Quit button.
- Added the new Trapping minigame!

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed the Voice Slider not affecting voices.
- Fixed Bachira and Chigiri still having white backgrounds in their games.
- Fixed the Idle Clicker not showing visually after a manual click.
- Fixed missing character data for new plushies introduced in v0.2.0.

Next update:
- 3 minigames are dropping in v0.4.0!

Looking ahead:
- v0.5.0 is going to be a big UI revamp.

entries.title: Blue Lock Clicker 0.2.0 Update
entries.body:
Blue Lock Clicker has been updated to version 0.2.0.

New Features:
- TONS of new plushies that now go up to 100,000!
- Plushies now have no background making them look better.

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed Total Clicks Counter going weird when going above 10,000.
- Fixed buttons in shop appearing weird on certain resolutions.

A LOT MORE next update as well as important bug fixes which I have been informed about!

entries.title: First release
entries.text: - Fully playable version of Blue Lock Clicker
